channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jose Manuel Calderon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jose Manuel Calderon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Jose Manuel Calderon
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:DeRozan on Calderon:

“I credit a lot of the player I am today to Jose... He's by far one of my favourite teammates of all-time”

DeMar DeRozan on Jose Manuel Calderon, Dec 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Jose Manuel Calderon, Jerian Grant
item.description:
Jeff Hornacek again sounded like a man who wouldn't mind if the Knicks acquired a point guard in free agency.

“The point guards we have, Jerian (Grant) is just a young player who is learning his way. He's going to get better and better as the years go on with the experience. And Jose (Calderon) is on the later side of it. So if we can find a point guard who, that's the 27, 28-year-old guy who has the experience and still has a lot of juice left, sure that would make us better. And the more shooters you can get, the better also,”

Jeff Hornacek on Jose Manuel Calderon, Jerian Grant, Jun 7, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Daniel Clark on Jose Manuel Calderon
item.description:
Marc Stein:GB's Dan Clark on Calderon dribbling out clock:

“Me and (Deng) both fouled him but the ref obviously didn't want to play the extra five min”

Daniel Clark on Jose Manuel Calderon, Aug 2, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Brian Colangelo on Jose Manuel Calderon
item.description:
“I’m not going to tell you that (Calderon) was thrilled about the trade, but in the end, this is about becoming a much better basketball team and that’s my No. 1 concern,”

Brian Colangelo on Jose Manuel Calderon, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Brian Colangelo on Jose Manuel Calderon
item.description:
Brian Colangelo:

“That adds to our already deep position there with Jose Calderon in the fold… Someone who’s performed at a very high level, that’s improved every year in the league. At 26, Kyle represents the future of the position.”

Brian Colangelo on Jose Manuel Calderon, Jul 12, 2012. Source: Toronto Sun.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Jose Manuel Calderon, Amir Johnson, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson, Andrea Bargnani
item.description:
Dwane Casey on the core players in Toronto:

“Andrea (Bargnani) is definitely a piece of the core that we have to utilize. He’s our star. DeMar Derozan is definitely an athletic part of our core, Jose Calderon, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson is in that group, and Amir Johnson. You’ve got the core now. The part you may have to add is a veteran piece, a veteran defender or whatever along with our draft pick is something that I’m sure Bryan and the staff are going to look at, but the core pieces are there to build on to use as building blocks. Those guys are the guys were gonna push, cajole, put an arm around, or whatever it takes to get to that next level.”

Dwane Casey on Jose Manuel Calderon, Amir Johnson, Jerryd Bayless, James Johnson, Andrea Bargnani, Jun 22, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.
